FAQ

Questions

Can a student handle client work?

Yes, at a scale that fits. I prototype first so you see progress before committing.

How long does a build take?

A landing page takes 3–5 days; larger builds take 2–3 weeks.

Do I own the result?

Yes. You receive the full source and a handoff walkthrough.

How does payment work?

A deposit to start and the balance on delivery, agreed in the scope.
